description: This PHP source file defines the PostsSubController class within the Goteo project. It manages administrative actions related to posts featured on the homepage, such as adding, removing, moving up/down, and listing posts, utilizing the Goteo framework's models and messaging system.

classes.name: PostsSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing post entries on the homepage within the admin interface, providing actions for adding, removing, reordering, editing, and listing posts.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Handles the action of moving a post up in the order on the homepage.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Handles the action of moving a post down in the order on the homepage.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the action of adding a new post to the homepage.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Handles removing a post from the homepage.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing all posts on the homepage.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method processing various actions such as add, remove, up, down, edit, and list of posts.
